title: EURO Classics: Spain 4-0 Italy, 2012 - UEFA.com
content: UEFA EURO - EURO Classics: Spain 4-0 Italy, 2012 - Infos. # EURO Classics: Spain 4-0 Italy, 2012. Whet your appetite for Tuesday's semi-final by watching the most emphatic final decider in EURO history in full – and get the background here. Italy will be favourites when they meet Spain in the UEFA EURO 2020 semi-finals on Tuesday, but La Roja could do worse than to recall the 2012 final, when they overwhelmed the Azzurri to complete an unprecedented hat-trick of major tournament wins. EURO 2012 semi-final: Germany 1-2 Italy. Champions in 2008, Spain hoped to become the first team to retain the Henri Delaunay Cup at UEFA EURO 2012. Spain actually drew 1-1 with Italy in their 2012 group-stage opener, but made it past France and then Portugal to reach the final. Winners in 1968 and runners-up in 2000, Italy had overcome England and Germany in the knockouts to get to Kyiv and the trophy match.
